author: MSc IT (Artificial Intelligence) Research Project
selection_policy: Empirical evidence-based shortlisting. Preprocessing superiority cannot be selected from pilot metrics alone; final strategy selection requires empirical evaluation on downstream CNN classification (Stage 14+).

discarded_candidates.reason_for_exclusion: Severely expands global dynamic range across non-breast background areas, amplifying sensor noise. Causes excessive saturation and whiteout in dense fibroglandular parenchyma, obliterating fine internal mass structures. Entropy decreased from 4.6143 to 4.5282 bits.

Indiscriminate low-pass spatial filtering washes out fine structural details and smooths out microcalcifications. Mean gradient dropped to 0.0642 (lowest of all methods). Inferior SSIM (0.7521) to median filtering.

Extreme computational complexity (~10-15 seconds per high-resolution mammogram, requiring > 10 hours for 3,568 images). Low restoration fidelity under Comparison B (PSNR 27.88 dB, SSIM 0.6349), indicating aggressive alteration of native tissue.

Highly specialized for salt-and-pepper noise (PSNR 52.77 dB), but inferior to standard median filtering on continuous Gaussian, Poisson, and Speckle noise models (overall PSNR 33.82 dB vs 36.06 dB for standard median).

discarded_candidates.strategy_name: Arbitrary Multi-Stage Pipelines (e.g. Denoise -> HistEq -> Sharpen)
discarded_candidates.reason_for_exclusion: Scientific boundary: Chaining operations that were never tested in Stages 5–11 violates reproducible research protocols. Only factorial combinations explicitly tested in Stage 7 (CLAHE + Unsharp Mask) are eligible for shortlisting.

evidence_gap_summary.cnr_limitation: Cropped ROI masks in CBIS-DDSM are unaligned with full mammograms; CNR recorded as NaN per AAPM/ICRU guidelines.
evidence_gap_summary.synthetic_noise_limitation: Stage 10 tested artificial synthetic noise; native clinical scans may not benefit from denoising and risk feature blurring.
evidence_gap_summary.pilot_size_limitation: Contrast and sharpening experiments were evaluated on 16 pilot mammograms; full population validation occurs in Stages 13–17.
